maria: Postmortem follow-up: recurring chain — cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> brief user errors. Need a single tracker, named owners, and a monthly cadence. Who can lead?:mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and rotations. Will create a sheet with owner, priority, SLA mapping. Can someone export 90 days of vendor-tagged incidents? :file_folder:
liam: I'll pull alerts/logs and produce a vendor-week heatmap with deploy markers and peak-hour overlays. ETA EOD today.
sre_lead: Audit CB thresholds and autoscaler backoff. Add a "failure_mode" and "short_term_mitigation" column. Our retries may be amplifying the blips.
kate: I'll map runbooks -> incident behaviors and propose quick patches for token jitter handling and cross-region retry. Draft Tue AM.
security: Reviewing KMS rotations and token TTLs; if rotations are synchronized we should add jitter/stagger. Report Mon.
oncall-bot: Linked INC-2026-0413-07; created tracker DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned AJ.
aj: Action items (please claim with :white_check_mark:):
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owners) — due 2026-04-15
- LIAM: vendor heatmap + 90d extracts — due 2026-04-13
- KATE: runbook gap doc + patches — due 2026-04-14
- SECURITY: rotation review + jitter proposal — due 2026-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: CB & autoscaler review — due 2026-04-16
- TEAM: propose monthly dependency failover drill (synthetic traffic) — proposal due 2026-04-20
maria: Two asks before close: add postmortem link in tracker and mark infra fallbacks as blocker. Scheduling Wed 09:00 sync to review heatmap + tracker. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. Tag @maria or @aj if blocked. :calendar: :eyes:
